hypothesis: Weight contractions into the task-typed L9H1/H4 value subspaces rank upstream attention heads and MLPs that causally write those states at their established contextual carrier banks.

frozen_population.selection: the same top/bottom weight-ranked components frozen before the query-position validation
frozen_population.has_carrier_bank: the three aligned tokens immediately after the sole has/had cue difference
frozen_population.is_carrier_bank: the two aligned tokens immediately after the sole is/was cue difference

intervention: Capture each full donor attention pre-c_proj head slice or full MLP output and exactly replace only paired carrier-bank positions in one recipient forward.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All sealed rows remain natively capable; every frozen component-row arm is unique; exact declared price recurs.
predictions.pred_b_weight_scores_predict_source_posi: Median Spearman(weight score, mean absolute recovery) across the four task/type cells exceeds 0.25 and at least three of four correlations are positive.
predictions.pred_c_top_weight_sets_are_source_enrich: Top mean absolute recovery exceeds bottom in at least three of four task/type cells.
predictions.pred_d_carrier_position_corrects_query_s: Carrier-position top mean absolute recovery exceeds the prior query-position top mean by at least 2x in at least three of four task/type cells.

decision: screen only if all four predictions pass; null on any scientific prediction failure; invalid on authority, capability, coverage, instrument, or price failure
heldout_policy: No outcome-dependent component selection or threshold tuning; all weight ranks, panels, carrier banks, and bars are frozen before GPU execution.
